definitions.gloss: oden; Japanese stew with various ingredients in broth
definitions.explanation: A winter comfort food consisting of various ingredients simmered in a light dashi-based broth. Common ingredients include boiled eggs, daikon radish, konjac, fish cakes, tofu, and more.

examples.english: My favorite oden ingredients are daikon radish and egg.

notes:
A quintessential Japanese winter dish. In Japan, おでん is famously sold at convenience stores (⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧) during the cold months, where customers can choose individual pieces from a heated pot at the counter.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧ (daikon radish)
- ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧ (boiled egg)
- ⟦こんにゃく→こんにゃく：04931_konnyaku⟧ (konjac)
- ⟦ちくわ→ちくわ：07479_chikuwa⟧ (tube-shaped fish cake)
- ⟦はんぺん→はんぺん：21733_hanpen⟧ (fish cake)
- ⟦{厚揚|あつあ}げ→厚揚げ：07478_atsuage⟧ (thick fried tofu)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- おでん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧ (oden ingredients)
- おでん{種|だね} (oden ingredients — more traditional term)
- おでん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{煮込|にこ}む→煮込む：05822_nikomu⟧ (to simmer oden)

Regional variations exist: ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧ style uses a darker soy-based broth, while ⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧ style uses a lighter dashi broth.
